Entry requirements for Computer Science
To be admitted to the master's programme in Computer Science, you must meet the admission requirements, submit all application documents and pass the selection. The same process applies to students with a bachelor's degree from a Swedish university.
Admission requirements
Bachelor's degree
Academic qualifications from an internationally recognised university equivalent to a Swedish bachelor's degree.
You can meet the requirement if you are in the final year of your bachelor's studies. Students at universities abroad must submit documents according to the instructions from University Admissions. Students at Swedish universities must have completed 150 credits in their programme by 3 February per the instructions from KTH.
English proficiency
English proficiency equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
You can meet the requirement with an English test, for example an overall IELTS score of 6.5 or a TOEFL score of 90. Depending on your country of previous studies you could also meet the requirement through completed upper secondary or university studies. Visit University Admissions to see all recognised English tests and what applies to your country of previous studies.
Specific requirements for Computer Science
A bachelor’s degree corresponding to 180 ECTS credits, or equivalent, including courses in:
Mathematics: four different subjects with a total of 28.5 ECTS credits. These subjects must include a course in Calculus in one variable, a course in Linear Algebra, a course in Probability Theory and Statistics, and a course in Discrete Mathematics.
Computer technology/Computer science and engineering/Computer science/Information technology: three different subjects with a total of 22.5 ECTS credits. These subjects must include a course in Object Oriented Programming, a course in Algorithms and Data Structures and an in-depth course in Algorithmic Complexity.
Within the programme track, there may be courses with additional requirements for special qualifications. The requirements are stated under the heading "Special eligibility" in the syllabus. Examples include the following:
• Multivariable analysis is a special eligibility requirement for compulsory courses within the tracks Data analysis and Cognitive systems.
• Human-computer interaction is a special entry requirement for compulsory courses within the Interaction Design track.
• Additional prerequisites may exist for some conditionally elective or recommended courses within the tracks.
Application documents
You need to submit all of the following documents according to the instructions from University Admissions.
General document
Degree certificates
Official certificates of your completed degrees. The documentation requirements vary between countries. Visit University Admissions to see what applies to your country.
General document
Transcript
Official transcript of courses and grades completed in your degree. Students from Swedish universities that use Ladok do not need to submit degree certificates or transcripts.
General document
Proof of English proficiency
What proof you need depends on whether you meet the requirement through a test or previous studies. Visit University Admissions to see what applies to you.
General document
Identification
A copy of passport with personal data and photograph, or other identification document.
Programme document
CV
KTH does not require a standard template, but the CV should clearly and concisely outline your education, work experience, computer literacy, qualifications and achievements (awards, publications, expertise knowledge and skills, etc.). It must be written in English.
Programme document
Letter of motivation
The letter of motivation explains why you have chosen this programme at KTH, what you hope to gain from it and how your interests and skills will help you succeed in your studies. Include an autobiography with the development and relevance of your academic and professional pursuits, extra-curricular activities and related experiences. KTH does not require a standard template, but it must be in English and less than 500 words. If you apply to multiple programmes that require a letter of motivation, you should submit one for each and state which programme each letter applies to at the top of the page.
Programme document
Letters of recommendation
Two letters of recommendation describing why you are the right choice for admission. Preferably, have one referee from an academic environment and one from a professional setting. If you apply for multiple programmes at KTH that request letters of recommendation, you may use the same letters for several programmes. You must provide an English translation if the letters are in a different language. The letters must have the referees' full contact details. If your referee wants to submit the letter themselves, they must send it by post to University Admissions and state your name and application number. They can not submit the letter via email.
programme document
Summary sheet
Submit the summary sheet for Computer Science, available via the link when the application opens. If you do not submit a complete summary sheet, it will negatively affect your evaluation score. Fill out all of the required information before submitting the form. For questions regarding the summary sheet, please contact the programme coordinator directly.
Selection criteria
The selection process is based on the following criteria: study results (grades from previous studies), motivation for the studies (awards, prizes and publications) and previous education.
Previous education is assessed on the quality that the previous education is considered to have in the subjects that are relevant to the education applied for. To assess this, UKÄ's quality review for Swedish higher education institutions is used. For foreign institutions of higher learning, university ranking is used. The merit evaluation is done on a scale of 1-75.
Acceptance rate
The acceptance rate for the master's programme in Computer Science for 2025 was 10 %. We admitted 58 students out of the 599 applicants that met the admission requirements. To increase your chances of getting admitted to KTH, we advise you to select more than one programme when applying. You can apply for up to four programmes and rank them in your order of preference.
Recognition of prior learning
Suppose you entirely or partially lack a formal requirement for a course or programme, but you believe you have the necessary knowledge to meet the requirement. In that case, you can apply for recognition of prior learning .

How to apply for master's studies
Master's studies at KTH start in August each year. Application for studies starting in 2025 is closed. Application for 2026 will open 16 October. You apply through University Admissions, the Swedish national application system. Some joint programmes have a later application deadline.
Watch our video guide
In this video KTH student Carrie guides you through the steps you need to take to apply for master's studies.
1. Choose your programmes
Explore our 62 master's programmes and find one or more programmes that fit your interests. On the programme pages, you can find detailed information about each programme: the courses, career opportunities, sustainability focus, and interviews with students and graduates. If you find it hard to choose, you can also connect with a student from the programme.
List of all master's programmes at KTH
2. Check the admission requirements
You can find the admission requirements for the programmes you want to apply to on the programme pages. There are both general and programme specific requirements. As the number of places for each programme is limited, and admission is highly competitive, meeting the admission requirements is a must for admission. If you think you have the background to meet the requirements, you are ready to start your application.
Admission requirements
3. Submit your application by 15 January
You apply through University Admissions, the Swedish national application system. Create an account and select your programmes. You can select up to four programmes and rank them in your order of priority.
How to apply to master's programmes (University Admissions)
4. Submit your required documents by 2 February
Submit all required documents to your application at University Admissions. We recommend that you submit your documents as soon as you have them ready and pay the application fee (if required). Early submission increases your chance of getting feedback if something is missing or incomplete. You can find instructions on how to submit your documents and how documentation requirements may differ between countries at University Admissions.
The required documents for each programme is listed on the page for Entry requirements .
5. Pay the application fee by 2 February
If you are not an EU, EEA or Swiss citizen, you have to pay an application fee of SEK 900. There are no application fee waivers. You can pay the fee directly on the University Admission website. If you are not required to pay the fee, you need to prove your citizenship with, for example, a copy of your passport.
Paying the application fee (University Admissions)
6. Check the admission results on 26 March
The admission results are posted in your account at University Admissions . You do not need to reply to your offer. If you are admitted, we will contact you and prepare you for your arrival in Stockholm.
Admissions results (University Admissions)

The following joint master's programmes have separate application processes and deadlines.

The general admission requirement for masters programmes at KTH is a completed Bachelor's degree, equivalent to a Swedish Bachelor's degree (180 ECTS), or equivalent academic qualifications from an internationally recognised university. Students in their final year of their under­­graduate education may also apply and if qualified, receive a conditional acceptance. English proficiency tests are waived for applicants with English as language of instruction (minimum 3 years of full-time higher education studies.
The specific admission requirement for students that apply for the Urban Planning and Design (UPD) specialisation track is a completed Bachelor’s degree in architecture, landscape architecture or urban planning. The previous study should include at least 30 hp in the field of urban design.
The specific admission requirement for students that apply for the Urban and Regional Planning (URP) specialisation track is a completed Bachelor’s degree in architecture or landscape architecture, civil engineering in the built environment or equivalent, urban and regional planning or social sciences relevant to the scope of the specialisation track. The previous study should comprise at least 30 hp in the field of urban, transport or regional planning, national/regional economy, geo­informatics or environmental sciences.
The specific admission requirement for students that apply for the Environment and Planning (EP) specialisation track is a completed Bachelor’s degree in architecture or landscape architecture, civil engineering in the built environment or equivalent, urban and regional planning, social or natural sciences relevant to the scope of the specialisation track. The previous study should comprise at least 30 hp in the field of urban, transport or regional planning, or environmental sciences.
The selection process for the Masters programme Sustainable Urban Planning and Design is based on a total evaluation of the following selection criteria: university, grade point average (GPA), relevant academic courses, motivation letter and working experience. For students with a degree in archi­tecture or landscape architecture, the portfolio is considered in the selection process.

requirements.requirement: Bachelor's degree from an internationally recognised university equivalent to a Swedish bachelor's degree.
requirements.requirement_zh: 持有国际认可大学颁发的、相当于瑞典学士学位的本科学位。

requirements.requirement: A bachelor's degree corresponding to 180 ECTS credits, or equivalent, including courses in Mathematics: four different subjects with a total of 28.5 ECTS credits. These subjects must include a course in Calculus in one variable, a course in Linear Algebra, a course in Probability Theory and Statistics, and a course in Discrete Mathematics.
requirements.requirement_zh: 持有相当于180 ECTS学分或同等学历的学士学位，其中包括数学课程：四门不同科目，总计28.5 ECTS学分。这些科目必须包含单变量微积分、线性代数、概率论与统计学、离散数学课程。

requirements.requirement: A bachelor's degree corresponding to 180 ECTS credits, or equivalent, including courses in Computer technology/Computer science and engineering/Computer science/Information technology: three different subjects with a total of 22.5 ECTS credits. These subjects must include a course in Object Oriented Programming, a course in Algorithms and Data Structures and an in-depth course in Algorithmic Complexity.
requirements.requirement_zh: 持有相当于180 ECTS学分或同等学历的学士学位，其中包括计算机技术/计算机科学与工程/计算机科学/信息技术课程：三门不同科目，总计22.5 ECTS学分。这些科目必须包含面向对象编程、算法与数据结构、算法复杂性深度课程。

requirements.requirement: English proficiency equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. Can be met with an English test, for example an overall IELTS score of 6.5 or a TOEFL score of 90, or through completed upper secondary or university studies.
requirements.requirement_zh: 英语水平相当于瑞典高中课程英语6。可通过英语测试满足，例如雅思总分6.5或托福90分，或通过完成的高中或大学学习满足。

requirements.requirement: Final-year bachelor's students can meet the requirement; students at universities abroad must submit documents according to University Admissions instructions; students at Swedish universities must have completed 150 credits in their programme by 3 February per KTH instructions.
requirements.requirement_zh: 本科最后一年学生可满足要求；在国外大学就读的学生须按University Admissions指示提交文件；在瑞典大学就读的学生须在2月3日前完成其专业150学分。

requirements.requirement: Submit official certificates of completed degrees.
requirements.requirement_zh: 提交已获学位的官方证书。

requirements.requirement: Submit official transcript of courses and grades. Swedish university students using Ladok do not need to submit degree certificates or transcripts.
requirements.requirement_zh: 提交课程和成绩的官方成绩单。使用Ladok的瑞典大学学生无需提交学位证书或成绩单。

requirements.requirement: Provide proof of English proficiency, depending on whether requirement is met through test or previous studies.
requirements.requirement_zh: 提供英语水平证明，具体取决于是否通过测试或先前学习满足要求。

requirements.requirement: Submit a copy of passport with personal data and photograph, or other identification document.
requirements.requirement_zh: 提交带有个人数据和照片的护照复印件，或其他身份证件。

requirements.requirement: Submit a CV, written in English, outlining education, work experience, computer literacy, qualifications and achievements (awards, publications, expertise knowledge and skills, etc.).
requirements.requirement_zh: 提交英文简历，概述教育背景、工作经验、计算机素养、资质和成就（奖项、出版物、专业知识和技能等）。

requirements.requirement: Submit a letter of motivation in English and less than 500 words, explaining why you have chosen this programme at KTH, what you hope to gain from it and how your interests and skills will help you succeed. Include an autobiography with development and relevance of academic and professional pursuits, extra-curricular activities and related experiences. If applying to multiple programmes, submit one for each and state which programme each applies to at the top.
requirements.requirement_zh: 提交英文动机信，不超过500字，解释为何选择KTH此专业、希望从中获得什么以及您的兴趣和技能如何帮助您成功。包含个人经历、学术和职业追求的发展及相关性、课外活动和相关经验。若申请多个专业，需为每个提交一封，并在页首注明适用范围。

requirements.requirement: Submit two letters of recommendation describing why you are the right choice for admission. Preferably one from an academic environment and one from a professional setting. Provide an English translation if in another language. Letters must have referees' full contact details. If referee submits themselves, they must send by post to University Admissions with your name and application number, not via email.
requirements.requirement_zh: 提交两封推荐信，说明为何您是合适的录取人选。最好一封来自学术环境，一封来自专业环境。若为其他语言，须提供英文翻译。信件须包含推荐人完整联系信息。如需推荐人自行提交，须邮寄至University Admissions并注明您的姓名和申请号，不可通过电子邮件。

requirements.requirement: Submit the summary sheet for Computer Science, available via link when application opens. A complete summary sheet is required; incomplete submission will negatively affect evaluation score.
requirements.requirement_zh: 提交计算机科学专业的摘要表，申请开放时通过链接获取。必须提交完整摘要表；不完整提交将影响评估分数。

requirements.requirement: Multivariable analysis is a special eligibility requirement for compulsory courses within the tracks Data analysis and Cognitive systems.
requirements.requirement_zh: 多元分析是数据分析和认知系统方向内必修课程的特殊资格要求。

requirements.requirement: Human-computer interaction is a special entry requirement for compulsory courses within the Interaction Design track.

official_verified.requirement: A bachelor's degree corresponding to 180 ECTS credits, or equivalent, including courses in Mathematics: four different subjects with a total of 28.5 ECTS credits. official_verified.requirement: A bachelor's degree corresponding to 180 ECTS credits, or equivalent, including courses in Computer technology/Computer science and engineering/Computer science/Information technology: three different subjects with a total of 22.5 ECTS credits. official_verified.requirement: English proficiency equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. Can be met with an English test, for example an overall IELTS score of 6.5 or a TOEFL score of 90, or through completed upper secondary or university studies.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 英语水平相当于瑞典高中课程英语6。可通过英语测试满足，例如雅思总分6.5或托福90分，或通过完成的高中或大学学习满足。

official_verified.requirement: Final-year bachelor's students can meet the requirement; students at universities abroad must submit documents according to University Admissions instructions; students at Swedish universities must have completed 150 credits in their programme by 3 February per KTH instructions.

official_verified.requirement: Submit official certificates of completed degrees.

official_verified.requirement: Provide proof of English proficiency, depending on whether requirement is met through test or previous studies.

official_verified.requirement: Submit a copy of passport with personal data and photograph, or other identification document.

official_verified.requirement: Bachelor's degree from an internationally recognised university equivalent to a Swedish bachelor's degree.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 持有国际认可大学颁发的、相当于瑞典学士学位的本科学位。

official_verified.requirement: A bachelor's degree corresponding to 180 ECTS credits, or equivalent, including courses in Mathematics: four different subjects with a total of 28.5 ECTS credits. These subjects must include a course in Calculus in one variable, a course in Linear Algebra, a course in Probability Theory and Statistics, and a course in Discrete Mathematics.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 持有相当于180 ECTS学分或同等学历的学士学位，其中包括数学课程：四门不同科目，总计28.5 ECTS学分。这些科目必须包含单变量微积分、线性代数、概率论与统计学、离散数学课程。

official_verified.requirement: A bachelor's degree corresponding to 180 ECTS credits, or equivalent, including courses in Computer technology/Computer science and engineering/Computer science/Information technology: three different subjects with a total of 22.5 ECTS credits. These subjects must include a course in Object Oriented Programming, a course in Algorithms and Data Structures and an in-depth course in Algorithmic Complexity.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 持有相当于180 ECTS学分或同等学历的学士学位，其中包括计算机技术/计算机科学与工程/计算机科学/信息技术课程：三门不同科目，总计22.5 ECTS学分。这些科目必须包含面向对象编程、算法与数据结构、算法复杂性深度课程。

official_verified.requirement: English proficiency equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. Can be met with an English test, for example an overall IELTS score of 6.5 or a TOEFL score of 90, or through completed upper secondary or university studies.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 英语水平相当于瑞典高中课程英语6。可通过英语测试满足，例如雅思总分6.5或托福90分，或通过完成的高中或大学学习满足。

official_verified.requirement: Final-year bachelor's students can meet the requirement; students at universities abroad must submit documents according to University Admissions instructions; students at Swedish universities must have completed 150 credits in their programme by 3 February per KTH instructions.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 本科最后一年学生可满足要求；在国外大学就读的学生须按University Admissions指示提交文件；在瑞典大学就读的学生须在2月3日前完成其专业150学分。

official_verified.requirement: Submit official certificates of completed degrees.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 提交已获学位的官方证书。

official_verified.requirement: Submit official transcript of courses and grades. Swedish university students using Ladok do not need to submit degree certificates or transcripts.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 提交课程和成绩的官方成绩单。使用Ladok的瑞典大学学生无需提交学位证书或成绩单。

official_verified.requirement: Provide proof of English proficiency, depending on whether requirement is met through test or previous studies.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 提供英语水平证明，具体取决于是否通过测试或先前学习满足要求。

official_verified.requirement: Submit a copy of passport with personal data and photograph, or other identification document.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 提交带有个人数据和照片的护照复印件，或其他身份证件。

official_verified.requirement: Submit a CV, written in English, outlining education, work experience, computer literacy, qualifications and achievements (awards, publications, expertise knowledge and skills, etc.).
official_verified.requirement_zh: 提交英文简历，概述教育背景、工作经验、计算机素养、资质和成就（奖项、出版物、专业知识和技能等）。

official_verified.requirement: Submit a letter of motivation in English and less than 500 words, explaining why you have chosen this programme at KTH, what you hope to gain from it and how your interests and skills will help you succeed. Include an autobiography with development and relevance of academic and professional pursuits, extra-curricular activities and related experiences. If applying to multiple programmes, submit one for each and state which programme each applies to at the top.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 提交英文动机信，不超过500字，解释为何选择KTH此专业、希望从中获得什么以及您的兴趣和技能如何帮助您成功。包含个人经历、学术和职业追求的发展及相关性、课外活动和相关经验。若申请多个专业，需为每个提交一封，并在页首注明适用范围。

official_verified.requirement: Submit two letters of recommendation describing why you are the right choice for admission. Preferably one from an academic environment and one from a professional setting. Provide an English translation if in another language. Letters must have referees' full contact details. If referee submits themselves, they must send by post to University Admissions with your name and application number, not via email.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 提交两封推荐信，说明为何您是合适的录取人选。最好一封来自学术环境，一封来自专业环境。若为其他语言，须提供英文翻译。信件须包含推荐人完整联系信息。如需推荐人自行提交，须邮寄至University Admissions并注明您的姓名和申请号，不可通过电子邮件。

official_verified.requirement: Submit the summary sheet for Computer Science, available via link when application opens. A complete summary sheet is required; incomplete submission will negatively affect evaluation score.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 提交计算机科学专业的摘要表，申请开放时通过链接获取。必须提交完整摘要表；不完整提交将影响评估分数。

official_verified.requirement: Multivariable analysis is a special eligibility requirement for compulsory courses within the tracks Data analysis and Cognitive systems.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 多元分析是数据分析和认知系统方向内必修课程的特殊资格要求。

official_verified.requirement: Human-computer interaction is a special entry requirement for compulsory courses within the Interaction Design track.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 人机交互是交互设计方向内必修课程的特殊入学要求。

official_verified.requirement: Additional prerequisites may exist for some conditionally elective or recommended courses within the tracks.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 专业方向内部分有条件选修或推荐课程可能设有额外先修要求。

official_verified.requirement: Selection process is based on study results (grades), motivation for studies (awards, prizes and publications) and previous education, assessed on a scale of 1-75.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 选拔过程基于学业成绩（以往成绩）、学习动机（奖项、荣誉和出版物）以及先前教育，按1-75分评估。

official_verified.requirement: Recognition of prior learning may be applied for if you lack a formal requirement but believe you have necessary knowledge.
official_verified.requirement_zh: 若您缺少正式要求但认为具备必要知识，可申请先前学习认定。
